title: Cube cooling: triple Fourier series (3D, analytic)
description:
3D transient heat: a steel cube of side L at T_i whose six faces are suddenly held at T_s; 41^3 cells, implicit Euler.
Analytic (product of three slab solutions): theta / theta_i = S(x) S(y) S(z), S(s) = (4/pi) sum_m sin((2m+1) pi s / L) / (2m+1) exp(-(2m+1)^2 pi^2 a t / L^2) (6 terms: valid for t > ~2 s); late times follow the first mode (4/pi)^3 exp(-3 pi^2 a t / L^2).
Probes tab: centre and off_centre (x = L/4, y = z = L/2) with the dashed series curves, plus centre_first_mode.
Derived values tab: theta at t_end and t_check, theta_mean (volume mean vs [(8/pi^2) sum exp(...)/(2m+1)^2]^3). Expect ~0.3 % at t_end (implicit-Euler lag t dt / (2 tau^2)), ~0.1 % at t_check.
Line profile tab (mid-height cut): T_x_line through the centre and T_diagonal corner to corner at t_end.

parameters.name: T_s
parameters.description: surface temperature in K held on all six faces from t = 0

parameters.name: k_st
parameters.description: stainless steel thermal conductivity in W/(m K)

parameters.name: L_cube
parameters.description: cube side (odd cell count: the centre is a cell centre)

parameters.name: x_off
parameters.description: x of the off-centre probe (a cell centre near L/4)

parameters.name: rate_1
parameters.description: slab first-mode decay rate in 1/s (0.0235); the cube's first mode decays at 3 rate_1 (tau 14 s)

parameters.name: t_end
parameters.description: study duration in s (~2.8 first-mode decay times)

parameters.name: t_check
parameters.description: time of the derived value theta_centre_check in s

parameters.name: S_mid_end
parameters.description: slab factor at mid-plane at t_end (higher terms < 1e-12)

analytic_curves.name: off_centre_series
analytic_curves.expression: T_s + (T_i - T_s)*(4/pi*(exp(-rate_1*t) - exp(-9*rate_1*t)/3 + exp(-25*rate_1*t)/5 - exp(-49*rate_1*t)/7 + exp(-81*rate_1*t)/9 - exp(-121*rate_1*t)/11))**2*4/pi*(sin(pi*x_off/L_cube)*exp(-rate_1*t) + sin(3*pi*x_off/L_cube)*exp(-9*rate_1*t)/3 + sin(5*pi*x_off/L_cube)*exp(-25*rate_1*t)/5 + sin(7*pi*x_off/L_cube)*exp(-49*rate_1*t)/7 + sin(9*pi*x_off/L_cube)*exp(-81*rate_1*t)/9 + sin(11*pi*x_off/L_cube)*exp(-121*rate_1*t)/11)
